pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyā avidūre aññatarassa pūgassa āvasathapiṇḍo paññatto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pubbanha samayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya pavisitvā piṇḍaṃ alabhamānā āvasathaṃ agamaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.4: manussā cirassāpi bhadantā āgatāti te sakkaccaṃ parivisiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.5: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dutiyampi divasaṃ …pe… tatiyampi divasaṃ pubbanha samayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pavisitvā piṇḍaṃ alabhamānā āvasathaṃ gantvā bhuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.12: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā anuvasitvā anuvasitvā āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.15: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.16: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.17: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū anuvasitvā anuvasitvā āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjissantī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.18: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave anuvasitvā anuvasitvā āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjathāti?
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.21: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā anuvasitvā anuvasitvā āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.23: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.24.1: “eko āvasathapiṇḍo bhuñjitabbo tato ce uttariṃ bhuñjeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:1.25: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā sāriputto kosalesu janapade sāvatthiyaṃ gacchanto yena aññataro āvasatho tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.2: manussā cirassāpi thero āgatoti sakkaccaṃ parivisiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.3: atha kho āyasmato sāriputtassa bhuttāvissa kharo ābādho uppajji. nāsakkhi tamhā āvasathā pakkamituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.4: atha kho te manussā dutiyampi divasaṃ āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavocuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.7: bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ anuvasitvā anuvasitvā āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjitunti kukkuccāyanto na paṭiggahesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.9: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.11: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.12: “anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā anuvasitvā anuvasitvā āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.13: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:2.14.1: “agilānena bhikkhunā eko āvasathapiṇḍo bhuñjitabbo tato ce uttariṃ bhuñjeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:3.1.6: pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññataraṃ bhojanaṃ, sālāyaṃ vā maṇḍape vā rukkhamūle vā ajjhokāse vā anodissa yāvadattho paññatto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:3.1.7: agilānena bhikkhunā sakiṃ bhuñjitabbaṃ tato ce uttariṃ bhuñjissāmīti patigaṇhāti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:3.2.1: agilāno agilānasaññī tatuttari āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:3.2.2: agilāno vematiko tatuttari āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc31:3.2.3: agilāno gilānasaññī tatuttariṃ āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
